title: Observation Tables
content:
Table 0 — Least Count of Travelling Microscope
Value of 1 Main Scale Division (M) = ____ cm
Total number of Vernier divisions (N) = ____
Least Count (LC = M/N) = ____ cm

Table 1.1 — Observation for Ring Diameter
Columns: S. No. | No. of Rings | Left MSR | Left VSR | Left Total (R1) | Right MSR | Right VSR | Right Total (R2) | Diameter D = |R1−R2| | D²
Typically recorded for ring numbers 20, 16, 12, 8, and 4.

Table 1.2 — Measurement of Diameter of Rings
Columns: S. No. | (n+m) | n | D²(n+m) in cm² | D²(n) in cm² | D²(n+m) − D²(n) in cm²
Rows pair up ring numbers at a fixed interval m, e.g. 20 & 16, 16 & 12, 12 & 8, 8 & 4.
The final row records the mean of the D² difference column, which is used directly in the wavelength formula.
